# Open Access Journals

> > A comprehensive platform for peer-reviewed open access journals spanning clinical medicine, medical sciences, and technology fields.

Open Access Journals provides a curated directory of open access publications and submission resources for researchers and authors. The platform emphasizes transparent, peer-reviewed scientific publishing across multiple medical and clinical specialties.

## Key Topics

- open access publishing
- peer-reviewed journals
- manuscript submission
- scientific literature
- academic publishing
- research dissemination
- clinical medicine
- medical sciences

- author guidelines
- peer review process
- research platform
- open access model
- scientific journals
- publication ethics

## Core Platform

- [Open Access Journals Homepage](https://www.openaccessjournals.com): Homepage listing open access journals across clinical, medical sciences and technology fields
- [About Us](https://www.openaccessjournals.com/about-us.html): Mission and background of Open Access Journals publishing platform
- [Journal Directory](https://www.openaccessjournals.com/journals.html): Directory of open access journals in medical and clinical sciences

## Featured Journals

- [Journal of Diabetes Management](https://www.openaccessjournals.com/journals/diabetes-management.html): Peer-reviewed open access journal covering diabetes management and related clinical research
- [Interventional Cardiology Journal](https://www.openaccessjournals.com/journals/interventional-cardiology.html): Peer-reviewed journal covering catheter-based heart disease treatments and interventional procedures

## Author Resources

- [Instructions for Authors](https://www.openaccessjournals.com/instructionsforauthors.html): Submission guidelines, ethics compliance and publishing policies for manuscript authors

## Support & Services

- [Contact Us](https://www.openaccessjournals.com/contact-us.html): Contact information and office location in London for editorial and general inquiries
- [Advertise](https://www.openaccessjournals.com/advertise.html): Advertising opportunities and promotion services for products and services

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.openaccessjournals.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy and data handling practices for openaccessjournals.com
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.openaccessjournals.com/terms-conditions.html): Legal terms, user agreement and service conditions
